seoTitle: Newsletter Name Generator: Ideas from Topic and Audience
metaDescription: Get newsletter name ideas from a topic and audience with common patterns like The Weekly, Digest and Brief. Template based, free, no signup.
intro: Enter topics, an audience and a rhythm to get dozens of name ideas.
why:
Newsletter names tend to follow a few patterns that readers recognise at a glance: a rhythm word, a role word like Digest or Brief, and a topic. Trying them all quickly gives you a shortlist.

It is template based, not creative, so expect to adjust. It cannot check availability: search the name, the domain and your email platform before you commit.
howTo: Add an audience and pick a rhythm.
Scan the list and shortlist favourites.

faq.q: Is the name checked for trademarks?
